title: HAL tests: Add NULL input validation for device getter functions
description: Five device getter functions (display, serial, battery, pmic, external_flash) return -EINVAL on NULL input but this path is untested. Similar functions (lora_device_get, gnss_device_get) already test NULL rejection. Add consistency by testing NULL rejection for all device getters at lines 210, 213, 219, 227, 245.
close_reason: Fixed: Added NULL input validation tests for display, serial, battery, pmic, and external_flash device getters in lichen/tests/hal/src/main.c
